items.name: Genie 4
items.summary: Generates worlds from text or an image in real time, now with sound and dialogue. Typed instructions change the weather, the camera or who is in the scene as you explore.
items.why: A participant can act inside a scene that keeps responding, instead of watching a fixed clip.
items.imgAlt: Frame from Google DeepMind's Genie 4 video: a crowned crane walks across snow while a text prompt is typed into the world, with the W A S D keys shown
items.credit: Picture: frame from Google DeepMind's official Genie 4 video on YouTube

items.name: PixVerse R2
items.summary: A real-time world you move through with the keyboard, with its own sound. Text, images or audio change it mid-session, and it remembers what has happened so far.
items.why: Because it remembers within a session, a participant's earlier choices can still shape the world later on.
items.imgAlt: Thumbnail of PixVerse's official R2 video: three generated worlds side by side, a fantasy kingdom, a cyberpunk city and an alien planet, linked by prompts
items.credit: Picture: thumbnail of PixVerse's official R2 video on YouTube

items.name: MiniMax H3
items.summary: Generates up to 15 seconds of 2K video with stereo sound from text plus up to 9 images, 3 video clips and 3 audio clips as references, and edits existing clips.
items.why: Open weights let a lab keep the exact model version for replication; in the EU, UK, US and South Korea, use needs MiniMax's approval.
items.imgAlt: MiniMax H3 announcement banner: the model's name over a violet jellyfish
items.credit: Picture: banner from MiniMax's official H3 announcement

items.name: Seedance 2.5
items.summary: Generates up to 30 seconds of video with synchronized sound in one pass, carries a scene on over several rounds with the same characters, and edits single timestamps, camera moves or a green-screen background.
items.why: A scene can be held constant while one cue changes, which is what an experimental manipulation needs.
items.imgAlt: Still from ByteDance Seed's one-take demo: a singer in a green sequined dress steps out on stage
items.credit: Picture: still from an official ByteDance Seed demo clip
